jobs.title: Filter-before-limit for search and entries: search_content's KNN candidate query constrained by kind/source (content_id IN (subquery), not a post-filter on the top-100 pool); /api/entries' kind filter pushed into the priority, since, and flagged-item storage queries (json_extract(c.analysis,'$.kind') IN (...)) in place of the shared Python post-filter block; /api/search gains a kind parameter that reuses /api/entries' validation through one shared helper, mirrors kind onto every result (including compact mode), and threads kind_filter through to storage.search_content; sqlite-vec floor raised to the tested >=0.1.6

prismis-cli search --kind: comma-separated kind values carried onto GET /api/search's kind param the same way `list --kind` already carries it to /api/entries, and the results table shows each item's kind
